يعتمدون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَمِدُونَ (yaʕtamidūna) /jaʕ.ta.mi.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# يُعْتَمَدُونَ (yuʕtamadūna) /juʕ.ta.ma.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
